_comment: Built-in ADK registry. Anchored beside adk_registry.py at the ADK root; relative values resolve against this directory. Adapter ids index the vetted pdk_adapters/ trees. Root ids resolve to directories (consumers join fixed relative paths); ADK is the ADK root itself, the others are the canonical sibling checkouts. PDK_ROOT and GDS_TO_KICAD_DATA_DIR are deliberately NOT ids: they stay validated paths (see the data-vs-code enumeration test).
